column1: #mapping_set_description: A synthetic curated set that re-asserts literal-subject mappings already
#  present in hca.sssom.tsv, so the same free text mapped the same way in two different sets collapses
#  into one row (ADR-0042). Subject texts are copied byte for byte from hca.sssom.tsv — a literal
#  subject's identity is its text, so any edit would split the group instead of forming it.
